text:
deploybot: automated rollout hit embed-cost threshold in region eu-west-1, suggested automatic rollback to v2.3.1 :warning:

maria: saw the alert, p95 tokens up 3x for embeddings calls after last kernel change. can someone confirm scope?

kevin: confirmed - only embeddings route /v1/embeddings with model rwd-embed-large-quant changed kernel flags in last deploy. cost per call spike, but latency is fine.

ops-anna: what's the immediate ask? auto-rollback will run in 10m unless we override.

maria: i'd like a short window to try quick revert of kernel flag (non-invasive) before full rollback. can we hold auto-rollback for 15m?

deploybot: hold requested by @maria. auto-rollback suppressed for 15m. reason=operator_hold

sre-james: re: rollback criteria — are we within threshold for customer impact? current QPS by tenant shows only 2 mid-market customers at 4x cost, not errors.

product-ella: PMs flagged billing risk. want communication to affected customers if we rollback. also release notes mismatch: docs still say quant flag default off, prod shows it on.

kevin: quick test plan: revert kernel flag on one canary node group, watch cost telemetry for 5m. if improves, propagate. commands:
```bash
# revert flag on canary pool
rdwctl pool update canary-eu --env "KERNEL_QUANT=off"
rdwctl rollout status canary-eu
```

ops-anna: i'm happy to run this now. tagging @sre-james to monitor metrics stream.

sre-james: watching. metrics: embedding_cost_per_1k_tokens and p90_token_latency.

(5m later)

kevin: canary results look good — cost down ~70% on canary, latency unchanged.

maria: ok we can avoid a full rollback if we propagate kernel flag revert to region. what's deployment plan? manual progressive roll or force pin previous image?

ops-anna: propose progressive roll across shards with 5% increments every 2m, with rollback automation re-enabled at 30% if cost doesn't improve. do we need a version pin to v2.3.1?

product-ella: pinning version reduces flakiness in notes. PMs prefer pin + kernel-flag revert to be explicit in release notes and customer comms. legal-bot: notify legal for any billing-facing messaging.

legal-bot: acknowledged. draft comms ready if you provide list of affected tenant IDs.

kevin: suggested plan: 1) revert kernel flag account-wide in eu-west-1; 2) pin service variant to v2.3.1 for 24h; 3) progressive rollout as ops proposed; 4) after 24h, evaluate and unpin.

maria: approve. i'll update release notes: add bullet "temporary kernel-flag revert to mitigate embedding cost spike; pinned runtime to v2.3.1".

deploybot: executing staged rollout: starting 5% -> commands sent to orchestration. auto-rollback remains enabled but threshold bumped to avoid noise during roll (temp_threshold=2x).

ops-anna: running the pin now:
```bash
rdwctl pin set service:embeddings eu-west-1 --version 2.3.1 --duration 24h --reason "cost mitigation"
```

sre-james: metrics good at 25%: cost down 60% cluster-wide so far, no error spike. continue.

kevin: adding a short runbook for oncall: if embedding_cost_per_1k_tokens > 1.5x baseline and affected_customers > 3, escalate to eng-releases with "rollback_exec" tag and execute full revert to v2.2.9.

product-ella: will prep customer note and PMs. legal notified. ops-anna please confirm once propagation complete.

ops-anna: propagation complete across eu-west-1. pin active. I will leave monitoring on for next 2 hours.

maria: thanks all — nice save without full revert. i'll close the follow-up ticket with the steps and updated release note snippet. :thumbsup:

deploybot: auto-rollback unsuppressed. thread closed unless new alerts appear.
